verdict.rationale: ReadMe's AI automations are the GitHub AI Writer and Linter rules. Their output passes through version-control workflows: branches keep changes from going live, Reviews add AI Linter checks or teammate approval, and bi-directional Git sync makes pull requests the review step, so automated changes can be reviewed and reverted via Git. Nothing shows that the automations themselves (Linter rules, AI Writer configuration) can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Missing for 10: versioning of automation definitions or rules, an explicit rollback mechanism for automations, a change history or audit trail for automation configuration, and independent corroboration.
